title: SIMULATING HUMAN-LIKE DAILY ACTIVITIES WITH DESIRE-DRIVEN AUTONOMY
reasoning: While the paper incorporates 'spiritual satisfaction' as one of the 11 dimensions of its agent's value system (based on the Theory of Needs), it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, or ethics. Instead, it uses spirituality as a parameter for simulating an agent's internal motivations for personal fulfillment and purpose.
